transcript_only_text:
Skills are inflation-proof. Whether
we're trading in Bitcoin or seashells in the future, if you've got value to give,
people will exchange for it. I recommend spending all excess cash on acquiring
skills until you have so much that you can't possibly spend on any more skills.
Cuz think about what it is from an asset perspective. They go up in value, no one
can take them from you, you get in a divorce, your skills are yours, no
government can confiscate them, they can't be taxed, they compound above all
other investments. You pay once for a skill and you continue to use it for the
rest of your life.
